Saffir-Simpson tropical-cyclone wind categories

Source: R/saffir_simpson.R
saffir_simpson.Rd

Provides the category thresholds and conventional display colours for the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Thresholds are sustained wind speeds in metres per second. Each threshold is the upper bound of its category, except for "Cat5", which has no upper bound.

Usage

saffir_simpson()

Value

A tibble with one row per category and columns category, threshold, unit, and color. threshold is numeric and "Cat5" has an infinite threshold.

Examples

saffir_simpson()
#> # A tibble: 7 × 4
#>   category threshold unit  color  
#>   <chr>        <dbl> <chr> <chr>  
#> 1 TD              17 m/s   #6EC1EA
#> 2 TS              32 m/s   #5FF   
#> 3 Cat 1           42 m/s   #FFFFD9
#> 4 Cat 2           49 m/s   #FBDA8C
#> 5 Cat 3           58 m/s   #F89F59
#> 6 Cat 4           70 m/s   #F6738A
#> 7 Cat 5          Inf m/s   #A188FC
